hospital_index: first adult non-gestational diabetes-recorded assessment with measurable serum creatinine; select before applying eGFR threshold and without using urine/CysC availability
hospital_time_window: same calendar day only; first specimen by collection/receipt time, review time fallback; keep time-source flags
urine_pairing: same patient and specimen identifier; random/spot urine only, no 24h
multiple_result_conflict: same specimen/analyte differing values -> missing and flagged; no averaging
urine_primary: recalculate from paired albumin and urine creatinine when possible; direct ratio otherwise; flag discordance
nhanes_diabetes: DIQ010=1 or DIQ050=1 or DIQ070=1 or LBXGH>=6.5; retain evidence flags, no fasting-glucose expansion
